mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_storage_usage(org_id, used_storage_bytes) VALUES (#{orgId}, 0) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE org_storage_usage osu SET used_storage_bytes = osu.used_storage_bytes + #{delta} FROM public.org o JOIN public.license_quota_policy p ON p.license_type = o.license_type AND p.status = 1 WHERE osu.org_id = #{orgId} AND o.org_id = osu.org_id AND osu.used_storage_bytes + #{delta} <= p.storage_quota_bytes
mapper.select: SELECT org_id, used_storage_bytes, used_gpu, used_cpu, used_memory_mb, updated_at FROM org_storage_usage WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE org_storage_usage osu SET used_gpu = osu.used_gpu + #{gpuDelta}, used_cpu = osu.used_cpu + #{cpuDelta}, used_memory_mb = osu.used_memory_mb + #{memoryMbDelta} FROM public.org o JOIN public.license_quota_policy p ON p.license_type = o.license_type AND p.status = 1 WHERE osu.org_id = #{orgId} AND o.org_id = osu.org_id AND osu.used_gpu + #{gpuDelta} <= p.max_gpu AND osu.used_cpu + #{cpuDelta} <= p.max_cpu AND osu.used_memory_mb + #{memoryMbDelta} <= p.max_memory_mb

UPDATE org_storage_usage SET used_gpu = GREATEST(0, used_gpu - #{gpuDelta}), used_cpu = GREATEST(0, used_cpu - #{cpuDelta}), used_memory_mb = GREATEST(0, used_memory_mb - #{memoryMbDelta}) WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
